brand_identity.name: FESTIVAL_OS
brand_identity.description: A high-contrast, dark-mode-first order management system designed for the chaos of a night festival. It prioritizes speed, legibility in low light, and touch accuracy.

headings.usage: All page titles, modal headers, and major stats. Use uppercase for extra impact.

body.usage: UI elements, buttons, inputs, table data.

mono.usage: Prices, Order IDs, Timestamps, Kitchen Tickets.

usage_rules.gradients: Avoid full gradients. Use gradients only for borders or text highlights.
usage_rules.glassmorphism: Use 'bg-zinc-900/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-white/10' for overlays and sticky headers.

visual_enhancers.textures: Add a subtle noise texture overlay to the body background to reduce digital flatness.

general.spacing: Generous. Use p-6 or p-8 for containers. Gap-4 or Gap-6 for grids.
general.grid_system: Bento Grid. Mix col-span-1, col-span-2, and row-spans to create interest.

landing.structure: Full-screen hero with background image. 3 large interactive cards for Role Selection centered in the viewport.

order_pos.structure: Split View. Left: Category Sidebar (15%). Center: Product Grid (55%). Right: Cart/Checkout (30%).
order_pos.mobile: Tabs for categories. Cart as a bottom sheet or drawer.

kitchen_display.card_style: High contrast, large text. Time elapsed must be prominent.

pickup_display.structure: Grid of 'Ready' orders. Massive Order Numbers. Green pulsing border for new ready orders.

buttons.default: h-12 px-6 font-semibold tracking-wide uppercase text-sm transition-all active:scale-95

cards.base: bg-card border border-border shadow-sm hover:border-primary/50 transition-colors

inputs.style: h-12 bg-input/50 border-transparent focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary transition-all text-lg

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. INSTALL FONTS: Add the Google Fonts import to index.css immediately.
2. CONFIGURE TAILWIND: Update tailwind.config.js with the colors and font families defined above.
3. GLOBAL CSS: Add the base styles (background color, text color) to index.css.
4. SHADCN: Customize the components in /components/ui to match the 'visual_enhancers' (radius, borders).
5. LAYOUT: Build the Role Selection page first using the 'festival_crowd' background.
6. DATA-TESTID: Ensure every button and input has a data-testid attribute.
7. NO GRADIENTS: Do not use gradients for backgrounds. Use solid dark colors with noise texture if possible.
8. USE LUCIDE-REACT: Use lucide-react for all icons.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
